acs.text_first_line: An approved result is held on the treatment, and the record is written before the row changes
A refused result carries its reason on the treatment
A second result is refused and writes no second record
Invalid input is refused field by field
A result that cannot be recorded does not happen
Two officers record a result at once
The result is read back from the treatment inside the scope
The four columns and the state are the only change, and the rule holds in the schema
